facts.text: I started my new job today.
I need to be at the office by 8:30 am.
I have been waking up at 6:30 am to get a head start.
I like creating a 30-minute buffer in the morning.
I have been exercising during the 30-minute buffer.
Exercising around 7:15 am gives me an energy boost for the rest of the day.
I do light exercise like yoga or jogging in the morning.
Now that I started my new job, I want to stay organized and manage my time effectively.
I am struggling with task prioritization and time management.
I feel like I have a lot of tasks to complete.
I am not sure which tasks to focus on first.
I am not sure how to allocate my time effectively.
I have been trying to make a to-do list.
It is hard for me to determine what is most important on my to-do list.
